items.say: Hi, I'm Lumi. Two minutes, then back to it. Flippers ready.
text: Looking at something close for a long time keeps your eye muscles working. Looking far away lets them ease off.
Sitting still for a while can leave your shoulders and neck stiff. A little movement loosens them up.
One idea to try: every 20 minutes, look at something 20 feet (about 6 metres) away for 20 seconds. We'll start with that, then move a bit.
